shots.standingOrder: Skim straight west 2.5 m above the sea toward the beach and the tower; hold the height over the water and stop 17 m short of the bamboo hall.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING + WATER (drone.terrain-skim). Starts over deep water 200 m east of the beach and skims west at 2.5 m along y 34808 to the beach below the Town Network portal: the bay glitters below, the bamboo halls with their blue-flame torches and the swirling portal grow ahead, and the 78 m Empyrean tower with its three floating Advocate spires rises out of the top of the frame (tiltDeg +12 keeps the spires in view until the last 3 s). Sea terrain types 18/20 under the camera for 92 % of the move; the only thing close is a shallow-water plant clump. shots.notes: CLOSING (drone.pass-over).
